guitar.modelsText: Kramer (Sambora signature, e.g. Wedge/Tour custom) / Ovation acoustic
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Sambora was a long-time Kramer endorser with his own custom guitars; Ovation was commonly used for acoustic ballads.
guitar.notes: Refined to lead with Kramer since that's Sambora's most documented brand association.

tone.target: clean acoustic-like intro with chorus/delay shimmer; later arena clean-crunch
tone.profile: clean acoustic-like intro with chorus/delay shimmer; later arena clean-crunch
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain focusing on chorus and delay for the acoustic intro, transitioning to a bright, clean-crunch tone suitable for arena rock verses.

rig.name: Bon Jovi - Wanted Dead Or Alive - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain clarity during arpeggios.
Enhance the acoustic-like attack and sustain for clean arpeggios.
Create the required shimmering, wide stereo chorus effect for the intro.
Provide light breakup and warmth for the 'clean-crunch' transition without heavy gain.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a clean boost/breakup, as dedicated low-gain preamps are limited. It must be kept subtle.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate clean tone of an American-style vintage amp.
Provide a focused, bright sound suitable for clean arpeggios and arena rock clarity.
Brighten the overall tone and enhance the high-end shimmer of the chorus/delay.
Provide the required delay repeats and shimmering echo effect.
Add subtle space and shimmer to the clean tone without muddying the arpeggios.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better articulation and clarity across both clean arpeggios and arena crunch.

proposals.reason: Enhance articulation for acoustic/clean tones and add depth to the arena crunch.
